Outcome 2: Processing and Market Linkages 2.3 Support Market Linkage of Farmers and ACs to SME and International Offtakers Oxfam will provide comprehensive technical assistance to Small and Medium Enterprises(SMEs) in the cashew sector, with HESED Agricultural Trading Co., LTD serving as the primary recipient and beneficiary of this support. HESED will then leverage the knowledge and capacity gained through Oxfam's technical assistance to provide valuable insights and support to 2 additional SMEs in the project. These include existing Oxfam i-SME project co-hort , GRAISEA project co-horst such asCambodia Agriculture Cooperatives Corporation ( CACC) and HESED.
Under Activity 2.4 (HESED TA), Oxfam will contract a technical consultant to provide structured, hands-on support to HESED to strengthen its performance as a cashew value-chain company and private-sector anchor. The TA package is organized into four practical components covering circular economy improvements, processing optimization, market readiness, and sourcing system coordination.
2.5 TARGETED BUYER SOURCING AND ENGAGEMENT The project will support international off-taker engagement and commercial linkage by matching Cambodian cashew SMEs with qualified buyers, distributors, and ethical sourcing partners in priority markets. The objective is to move beyond general networking and create structured pathways that lead to real buyer conversations, sample requests, follow-upnegotiations, and early-stage off-take agreements. This approach responds to what Cambodian SMEs value most for business growth: direct access to international buyers and the opportunity to build credibility through face-to-face engagement and market exposure.

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib is one of the 17 national affiliates of the Oxfam International Confederation. It started life in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Working together in confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education forall, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam established this country office to support local organizations and projects. Through this local office Oxfam Novib directly contributes towards this project#s implementation.
